CFG.TASK_LIST_DESC: Select which Google Tasks list to sync with.
CFG.INCLUDE_COMPLETED_DESC: Show already completed Google Tasks when searching for tasks to import.
CFG.CUSTOM_CLIENT_ID_DESC: Google Cloud Desktop OAuth Client ID with the Google Tasks API enabled.
CFG.CUSTOM_CLIENT_SECRET_DESC: Google Cloud Desktop OAuth Client Secret (non-confidential installed-app credential; synced with provider config).
CFG.CUSTOM_REDIRECT_URI_DESC: Optional loopback redirect URI (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8976/callback). Leave empty for the default automatic loopback port.
